data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

GRAHAM CAPITAL WEALTH MANAGEMENT's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in ELME and SFBC.

On September 29, ELME received a delisting or listing-standard notice in an 8-K Item 3.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/104894/000010489426000117/elme-20260928.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and details on a four-week fund pilot?

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
